about: GameCube layouts of the game data tables, generated by datatables.py from the decomp headers (compiler debug info, not hand-written). Offsets/sizes are GameCube (big-endian, 4-byte pointers). kind=pointer/string_pointer fields are relocated addresses. bit_shift counts from bit 0 = lowest bit of the storage unit; CodeWarrior fills bitfields from the top bit.

fields.name: name
fields.comment: 0x18: a message (text) ID, not a string
